title: 第23章 哥，能看看你千万账户吗？
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
李西雄无话可说。

    他确实很恐惧。

    不然也不会获利离场。

    人性恐惧，会在利益放大后，也会随之放大。

    “西海，你还不走吗？”

    李西雄忍不住问道。

    “不急。”

    李西海笑道：“西朋说的对，反正都是赚的，亏了就亏了。”

    李西雄苦笑道：“年轻人心态就是好，想得开。”

    “哥，你是不一样。”李西海说了一句。

    毕竟，家里知道他炒股亏钱，还补窟窿。

    闹得不可开交。

    这回本大赚，抽身出来，是人之常情。

    股市这玩意儿，吃过一次亏后，就越会担惊受怕的。

    宋锦一直没说话，只是在默默的关注着。

    就在这时。

    包厢门突然被推开了，走进来两个警察。

    “刚子？”

    “刚哥？”

    “西海？”

    进来的警察是杨刚。

    两边都很诧异。

    “玩游戏啊。”

    杨刚扫了一圈，见到宋锦眼神不由停留了一会儿。

    “对，无聊玩玩。”

    李西海起身，递了一支烟过去，道：“你这事？”

    “例行检查。”

    杨刚没多说什么，李西海也没多问，拿出身份证来。

    “你们就不用了。”

    “别，按规矩来。”

    “行。”

    扫了身份证后，杨刚临走前，低声说道：“最近有个流窜犯到我们江云，正在排查。”

    “你注意点，有事情立马打电话。”

    李西海点了点头，“有时间约一下。”

    “最近应该没空，等我电话。”

    杨刚做了个打电话的手势，便带着辅警离开了。

    “刚哥是治安大队的，他怎么会来网咖检查？”

    李西朋有点好奇的问道。

    “说是有个流窜犯到我们县了，正在排查。”

    李西海道：“具体情况也不清楚，你们也注意点。”

    刚说完，就听到外面传来喧哗的声音。

    几人出去，站在包厢门口，就看到不远处围着一群警察，然后押着一个人离开。
content_en:
Li Xixiong had nothing to say.

    He was indeed afraid.

    Otherwise, you won’t be able to leave the market with a profit.

    Human fear will be magnified when interests are magnified.

    "Xihai, aren't you leaving yet?"

    Li Xixiong couldn't help but ask.

    "No rush."

    Li Xihai smiled and said: "Xipeng is right, you make money anyway, if you lose, you lose."

    Li Xixiong smiled bitterly and said: "Young people have a good attitude and can think openly."

    "Brother, you are different." Li Xihai said.

    After all, his family knew that he was losing money by trading in the stock market and was trying to make up for the losses.

    It was such a big fuss.

    This time I have made a lot of money, so it is human nature to take a break.

    In the stock market, after you suffer a loss, you will become more frightened.

    Song Jin didn't speak, just paying attention silently.

    Just then.

    The box door was suddenly pushed open, and two policemen walked in.

    "Gangzi?"

    "Brother Gang?"

    "Xihai?"

    The policeman who came in was Yang Gang.

    Both sides were surprised.

    "Playing games."

    Yang Gang glanced around and couldn't help but stare at Song Jin for a while.

    "Yes, just for fun."

    Li Xihai stood up, handed over a cigarette, and said, "What's this about you?"

    "Routine inspection."

    Yang Gang didn't say anything more, and Li Xihai didn't ask any more questions and took out his ID card.

    "You don't have to."

    "No, follow the rules."

    "Okay."

    After scanning his ID card, Yang Gang said in a low voice before leaving: "A rogue criminal has recently entered our Jiangyun, and we are investigating."

    "Be careful and call me immediately if anything happens."

    Li Xihai nodded, "Let's make an appointment when we have time."

    "I probably won't be free recently. Wait for my call."

    Yang Gang made a gesture of calling and left with the auxiliary police.

    "Brother Gang is from the security brigade, why would he come to the Internet cafe to check?"

    Li Xipeng asked curiously.

    "It is said that a fugitive criminal has arrived in our county, and we are investigating."

    Li Xihai said: "I don't know the specific situation, so you should pay attention."

    As soon as he finished speaking, he heard noise coming from outside.

    A few people went out and stood at the door of the box. They saw a group of police officers surrounding them not far away, and then they escorted a person away.
title_en: Chapter 23 Brother, can I see your multi-million account?
